intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna sits down beside you and folds her hands in her lap. They stay there for almost a minute.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then the left one drifts toward the pocket labeled *twine*. She puts it back.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “So far it’s harder than getting Pim to take his cough syrup.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Stay if you like. That’s the whole prescription.”

options.labelText: “Want a distraction? I could tell you about the time I lost an argument with a goat.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You explain. It takes a while. By the end, all her twine is sorted by length.

options.labelText: “Give me the hand that keeps wandering. I’ll keep it out of the twine.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She studies your hand like a sample of unknown origin. Then she puts hers in it.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Nothing else happens for a good while. The twine stays in its pocket.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Four minutes without sorting anything. Don’t move.”
